# Credits

<!-- Generated from src/audio/sounds.json by `node scripts/assets/build-credits.mjs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Leaper is a non-commercial, open-source game. These are the people and
projects whose work it uses. The same list is shown in the game's credits.

## Licence notes

- NonCommercial: "M4_Rifle_Fire" by Luca2399 (CC BY-NC 4.0) is used for M416 shot, M416 reload. That is fine for this non-commercial game; any paid, ad-supported or promotional use needs a replacement or the author's permission.
- Every sound's source, cut and licence is recorded in `src/audio/sounds.json`; the originals are in `assets/audio/sources/`.

## Code and art

- [three.js](https://threejs.org/): mrdoob and the three.js authors (MIT), 3D rendering.
- [ONNX Runtime Web](https://onnxruntime.ai/): Microsoft (MIT), runs the Leaper's trained brain in the browser.
- [three-mesh-bvh](https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh): Garrett Johnson (MIT), fast ray tests against the junkyard.
- Lola, her guns and animations: from the project owner's Blender files, original authorship to be confirmed by the owner, see assets/PROVENANCE.md.
- The junkyard: props generated by the project's own scripts, arranged in Blender, assets/blockmesh/, see assets/PROVENANCE.md.
- The Leaper: built in code by the project, src/robot/createHexapod.js, see assets/PROVENANCE.md.

The game's own code has no licence chosen yet. What is known about where the
character, map and Leaper came from is recorded in `assets/PROVENANCE.md`.
